Although it includes a reported 7X result, a conditional four-to-eight-times expectation, external code links, and a stated 100–900 MATIC requirement, these details create risk and an action path without establishing that the demonstration is deceptive.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational and programming demonstration involving Solidity code, Remix, MetaMask, contract deployment, funding for gas and flash-loan execution. The material also contains return claims, but the directly observed instructional workflow supports the education and technology subtype.
